verdict.rationale: Better Stack's marketing documents alerting over voice call, SMS, email, Slack, Teams and push. The docs confirm phone-call alerts, where you press 1 to acknowledge. However, the evidence never shows an on-call engineer choosing their own channels or setting per-channel notification rules; escalation policies cover who is alerted and in what order, not how each person is reached. Missing for 10: user-configurable per-channel notification rules, per-user channel selection docs, independent/hands-on corroboration.
